modern: No man is tired of receiving what is useful. But it is useful to act in keeping with nature. Do not, then, be tired of receiving what is useful by doing it for others.
original: No man is tired of receiving what is useful. But it is useful to act according to nature. Do not then be tired of receiving what is useful by doing it to others.
